title: EKOR and BT stratifications for basic unramified $\mathrm{GU}(1,n-1)$ Rapoport-Zink spaces
summary: In this paper, we establish the relation between the Ekedahl-Kottwitz-Oort-Rapoport stratification and the Bruhat-Tits stratification on basic unramified $\mathrm{GU}(1,n-1)$ Rapoport-Zink spaces with arbitrary parahoric level. More precisely, we prove that every basic EKOR stratum is a disjoint union of copies of an explicitly defined fine Deligne-Lusztig variety. Using this comparison and the closure relations for fine Deligne-Lusztig varieties, we give an explicit combinatorial description of the closure of every basic EKOR stratum.
